props.Text: Race across floating islands and grab every gem before the clock runs out.
Made with RIFT   ·   WASD to move   ·   Space to jump   ·   Right mouse to look
Everywhere. Grab them on the run.
Only in hard places. Follow the light beam.

Pick gems up quickly one after another for a COMBO: x2, then x3 points.
Cyan pads launch you to other islands. Green pads give you a speed boost.
